title: The Signature Vision: Full-Dive VR Systems
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Full-Dive VR Systems.
description:
The Signature vision of Full-Dive VR Systems does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature system hulls program, charter one: master dive rigs at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale system logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate sensory mapping systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Full-Dive VR Systems becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Full-Dive VR Systems
definition: Estimates Full-Dive VR Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Full-Dive VR Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Full-Dive VR Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Full-Dive VR Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Full-Dive VR Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 29068 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where dive rigs monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or sensory mapping maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Full-Dive VR Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Full-Dive VR Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Full-Dive VR Systems — vR engaging all senses fully.

Phase 1 — Prove (dive rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sensory mapping): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (session limits): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and VR users-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
